{{Quote|If you run from neks, or Vong, they won't respect you. They'll chase you, drag you down, and kill you. |Wedge Antilles|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>}}
'''Neks''', also known as '''Cyborrean battle dogs''', were vicious and primitive [[Dog/Legends|dog]]-like creatures bred on [[Cyborrea/Legends|Cyborrea]] by the [[Cyborrean]]s.

==History==
They were originally bred for use as animal weapons during the wars that erupted on Cyborrea, although they became hot black market items later on. The neks were fitted with armor and [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] implants. The implants made the canines fearless, increased their battle prowess, and allowed the nek's handler to control the animal in battle.

[[File:Nek.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Neks being released on Coruscant in 10 ABY]]
They were used by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Frane]] of [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]] to hunt [[kudana]]. King Frane's youngest son, [[Taroon (Rutanian)|Taroon]], tried to use modified [[seeker]] droids to destroy the kennels where the neks were housed, in an attempt to frame his older brother [[Leed]] so that he would be denied the throne of Rutan. His plan was stopped when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his apprentice [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] told him that one of his friends was currently caring for the neks at the kennels.

During the [[Imperial Civil War]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], scavenger groups used neks to chase off enemies.<ref name="DE1">[[Dark Empire 1|''Dark Empire'' 1]]</ref> On [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Ben Skywalker]] was attacked by a pack of wild neks resulting in the death of one and the injuring of two others.

A curse used on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] went: "Nek take it."
Gigantic stone neks decorated the entrance of the academic hospital on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]] had a talent of [[Force vision/Legends|sensing fear]] and hunting fugitives or escapees; fellow Dark Jedi [[Yun]], who disliked him, likened him to a Nek battle dog.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
